newsitem.title: PERU: Peru govt seeks extension to legislative powers.
newsitem.headline: Peru govt seeks extension to legislative powers.

text.p: The Peruvian government formally requested on Tuesday that Congress grant a 30-day extension to its special legislative powers.
A letter to Congress signed by President Alberto Fujimori and Prime Minister Alberto Pandolfi said the extra time was needed "urgently" to perfect a new law governing the bank system.
Congress, where the government has a comfortable majority of 70 seats in the 120-member single chamber, is due to debate the request on Thursday.

In May, Congress granted the government special powers for 120 days to decree a package of legislation, including the bank law and others still to be approved governing private sector debt and the regulations of the local stock exchange.
These special powers were due to end September 28.
